title: How does offstage route a command, or a cloud job, to somewhere off your screen?
audience: Engineers onboarding to offstage and offstage cloud
scope: Local `offstage run` across headless/container/session lanes, plus cloud tasks, sandboxes and agent runs on fleet Mac slots.
omissions: GitHub Actions runner tasks, Clerk sign-in, Stripe billing and Resend mail on the plane
Slot login seeding (loopback RFB), cmio/SEP recovery, fleetd installs, probe verb
Marketing site (Vercel), launch film, bench and chaos tests: not product runtime

notes.title: Routing: lane choice and cloud dispatch
notes.text: classify() only reads argv/repo files: session > container > headless. A refuse signal (installer, .pkg/.dmg, hdiutil) blocks every lane, even with --lane; --lane headless can't downgrade. Cloud submit checks auth, GUI gate, capacity, credit; /claim serves sandboxes, then fair-by-team tasks.

notes.title: State and result lifecycle
notes.text: Local: run() makes .offstage/runs/<id>; a zod-checked LaneResult is saved best-effort as result.json. Cloud: in-memory state is snapshotted atomically to /data/plane.json every 2 s and on SIGTERM; a crash can lose ~2 s of acked writes. Orphaned claims requeue on restore; orphaned runs fail.

notes.title: Failure, isolation and retry
notes.text: Lanes never throw or use your screen: no substrate → skipped (exit 69). sessiond checks peer uid; refuses input on console. Cloud: unstarted claims requeue after 20 s (3 tries); a box silent 2 min fails running tasks, no rerun. Slots claim only behind a fail-closed pf guard; reset gives a new uid.
notes.source: src/contract/index.ts, native/sessiond/Peer.swift, native/sessiond/Input.swift, cloud/src/core/queue.ts, src/fleet/lan-guard.ts, src/fleet/reset.ts

views.title: How does `offstage run` choose a lane and keep the work off your screen?
views.scope: CLI/MCP classifies argv, refuses or dispatches to the headless, container or helper-session lane, writes result.json; plus direct session verbs.

views.title: How does a cloud task reach a Mac slot and come back as a result?
views.scope: SDK submits; the plane admits and queues; a box claims it, runs it as the slot uid, reports, uploads artifacts and resets; state snapshots to /data.

views.title: How do sandboxes and agent runs drive a slot through the plane?
views.scope: SDK or MCP opens a sandbox; ops relay to the box by long-poll; the in-slot harness calls Claude via the plane's proxy; closing resets the slot.

views.title: What does the web console talk to, and where is its state kept?
views.scope: Console SPA served by the plane: sign-in, keys, billing, usage and replays, persisted in the plane's /data snapshot and artifact files.
